events.title: [10.23Demo Update] Art Asset Improvements
events.summary: Hello everyone, We received feedback from some players that certain assets in the Demo looked unpolished. We take this seriously and would like to clarify: AI assistance was indeed used in producing some of our game assets. However, all of these assets were manually adjusted before being implemented.
